title: Hidden Locations
wikitext:
{{Outdated}}

'''Hidden Locations''' are areas in SkyBlock that are not meant to be accessible and can only be viewed by finding unintended ways in, or by downloading map data and finding where it is hidden.

Please note most of these locations require an [[Aspect of the End]] or glitching through walls by using the [[Horse Pet]] for example.

'''This page is just meant for fun, and this knowledge serves no practical purpose.'''

== Windmill Roof ==
'''Location:'''{{Coordinates|70|76|-148}}
You used to be able to get inside the roof of the windmill at the Farm with the [[Aspect of the End]]. You could stand inside the windmill and look up at the mossy stone brick, jump and use the [[Aspect of the End]]'s ability twice. 

{{Alpha Network|small=yes}}

This no longer exists because of the new map.

[[File:Minecraft 1.15.2 4 13 2020 8 49 10 PM.png|200px]]

== Catacombs Entrance Cage ==
'''Location:  '''-67, 61, -136

You can get inside the cage at Catacombs Entrance with an [[Ender Pearl]].

Go away from the cage so you can throw an ender pearl into the cage (Pearls go through iron bars and glass)

Another way of getting into the cage is to sprint towards the cage and use an [[Aspect of the End]] to teleport into the catacombs entrance cage. This may take a few attempts.

== Secret Spawn Bunker ==
'''Location:''' {{Coordinates|9|65|-100}}

The Secret Spawn Bunker is a small room at spawn with 2 torches, logs in 3 (or 5, depending on how you count) corners, and a staircase leading to nowhere.

[[File:2020-01-11_19.54.06.png|200px]]

== Jungle Island Parkour ==
'''Location:''' {{Coordinates|-404|85|-72}}

An unreleased parkour course. Much of the outside of the course is easily accessible (starting at {{Coordinates|-446|99|-93}}). There was a wall at {{Coordinates|-443|99|-90}} that prevented further entry into the hidden internal part of the course, but it has been removed. It is actually possible to see hidden the area by looking down through the ice at {{Coordinates|-405|117|-73}}. It is also possible to glitch through the stone wall using an [[Aspect of the End]] or a horse pet (which is easier).  At the end of the course is a slime launcher which doesn't actually work yet. It leads to the surface but is currently closed off.

At some unknown time, this area is completely inaccessible. The ice that would normally at the bottom of the lake and the space below it has been filled with proper blocks. The outer parkour area that would normally lead to the closed off entry is also removed save for one single platform at the start. More information is required on the possibility of the the entire area being filled with blocks or not.

[[File:Jungle_Parcour_End.png|200px]]

== Stone Pillar Hallway ==
'''Location:''' {{Coordinates|2|70|50}}

A large hallway with very tall stone pillars with sea lanterns attached to them. Nothing seems to naturally connect to this hallway, or hint at its use. It's located inside the hub [[Mountain]], with one end near the [[Wizard Tower]] / over the right-wing of the High-Level Mountain area (see above), and the other end near the [[Carrot]] farm in the base of the Mountain (which is near the [[Library]]).

With the Hub revamp, while this structure still exists, it has been filled in with stone blocks replacing all air blocks. However, the andesite pillars remain intact.

[[File:Stone_Pillar_Hallway.png|200px]]

== Wizard Tower Roof ==
You can get inside the Roof of the Wizard Tower using the [[Aspect of the End]]/[[Aspect of the Void|Void]]'s Etherwarp Transmission ability. There is an odd stone pillar 
hanging from the roof.

[[File:Wizard_Tower_Roof.png|200px]]
[[File:Wizard tower.png|200px]]

== Community Center 3rd Floor ==
You can find there's an extra floor in the [[Community Center]]. Using [[Aspect of the End]] you can teleport inside. First, start breaking the glass at {{Coordinates|-3|77|-116}}. Then quickly teleport inside with your [[Aspect of the End|AOTE]]. 

Or you can just teleport inside using an ender pearl. (Same as in Catacombs Entrance Cage) 

This no longer exists due to the new map.

[[File:2020-03-03 19.27.36.png|200px]]
[[File:Community Center 3rd Floor.png|200px]]

== Community Center Basement ==
'''Location:''' {{Coordinates|-30|53|-106}}
There are two parts in the Community Center's basement. You can glitch into the first part by using the Horse pet glitch on the rightmost wall panel on the back, at {{Coordinates|-1|68|-118}}. In the first part, you can glitch into the second part at {{Coordinates|1|68|-115}}. In the second part, you can glitch into the first part at {{Coordinates|2|68|-114}}.

Rats can be found here when 56ms is a Minister. It is unknown whether this existed before the Village was destroyed by [[Dante]].

[[File:Community center basement 1.png|200px]]
[[File:Community center basement 2.png|200px]]

== Sponge Room ==
'''Location:''' {{Coordinates|-30|53|-106}}
You can find this small space with sponges by using rock pet and horse pet glitch at east south corner of the [[Hexatorum]]'s (formerly dubbed the ''Guild House'') basement.

[[File:Hidden Sponge Room.png|200px]]

However, likely due to the introduction of the [[Shen's Auction]] area sitting close the it, the space has been covered up, but small parts of the sponge still remain and can still be seen if the blocks at the corner are broken.

[[File:Hexatorium-secret-sponge.png|200x200px]]

== Outside of The Dungeon Hub ==
It is possible to access this location by using the {{AN|Ether Transmission}} ability on the {{Item|Gray Wool}} on the ceiling of the Dungeon Hub.

It was previously possible to access this location by spawning a {{Item|Horse Pet}} in the dungeons hubs door, which is right behind {{NPCSprite|Mort}}. The glitch however is patched and the Dungeon Hub uses mining fatigue to prevent breaking blocks. 

[[File:Dungeon Hub Outside.png|200px]]

== Ceiling of the Dwarven Mines ==
In previous versions of the Dwarven Mines before the Crystal Hollows update, there exists a hole starting from {{Coordinates|66|222|-83}} that would lead straight up to the ceiling of the [[Dwarven Mines]]. Players would use the the Aspect of the End to climb up the hole but must use other means to push themselves up the ceiling (using the [[Grappling Hook]] or [[Tarantula Boots]]) as the build limit prevented the use of teleportation abilities. It is mostly bare up there with the exception of the secret text that says "WHY ARE YOU UP HERE?", "COS", and "THE NERVE!". It was also a useful spot to mine cobblestone at the time with how expansive it was. The hole is now blocked off with the release of the Crystal Hollows update.

Other methods getting up there involving the Horse pet are also patched out.

A video showing the message can be seen [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8g46Oo2-UJA here].

== Dark Auction ==
You get in the [[Dark Auction]] area in the hub by glitching thorough the wall using ghost blocks and [[Bonzo's Staff]], followed by another ghost block exploit to get around the iron door at the basement. This area is commonly used by high-level players to grind [[Headless Horseman|Headless Horsemen]] as the area is blocked off, preventing it from being pushed into unfavorable spots or being swarmed by too many players at once.

While attending the Dark Auction itself, it was previously possible to walk out the basement and the shack using a Horse pet. However, pets and many abilities have since been disabled in Dark Auction lobbies, and custom mining mechanics are put in place to prevent ghost block exploits.

[[File:Dark Auction Inside.png|Inside the Dark Auction House|200px]]
[[File:Dark Auction Basement.png|The Dark Auction basement|200px]]

== Cow Lab ==
In the [[Glowing Mushroom Cave]] after the Moby Chumming update, a secret area can be found starting from blocked off ladders at {{Coordinates|175|43|-469}} under the dirt. Using ghost block exploits, it is possible to climb down these ladders and see what appears to be a secret lab of sorts with two upside-down cows (tagged as Dinnerbone), both of which can be killed and appear to act as normal cows otherwise. It is unknown what this area is supposed to be considering the update it appeared in.

This has now become [[Underground Lab|Jake's Lab]] and is used in various stages of Beth's quest.

[[File:Secret-Cow-Lab.png|frameless|200x200px]]
